thought:
The user wants me to verify 80 essence statements about Chinese Taoist/medical texts against web sources, and return only those that are partial or inaccurate in a specific JSON format.
Let me continue verifying systematically. I noticed some potential issues:
Entry 49 is accurate - 书分三十篇，每篇...每日炼丹功法 - so 30 days/30 sections with hymn/praise - entry's "mỗi ngày một thiên" is correct (30 sections as 30-day system).
Let me also quickly verify a few more that might be wrong:

results.title: 唱道真言
results.issue: Author field follows Daozang jiyao catalog (南極仙翁傳／鶴臞子集), but the text and modern scholarship consistently attribute transmission to 青華老人 (青華上帝 of 南極天宮), with 鶴臞子 as compiler—not the popular longevity deity 南極仙翁.

results.title: 真龍虎九仙經
results.issue: Daozang original title is only 「羅葉二真人注」, not an explicit 原題 naming 葉靜能. Tongzhi lists 葉靜能撰 with 羅公遠、一行注; many modern IDs take the pair as 羅公遠、葉法善—three different attribution schemes are conflated.

results.title: 洞玄靈寶自然券儀
results.issue: Dated 「khoảng Bắc triều」 is uncertain: the type of 自然券 belongs to early Lingbao 中盟 transmission, but the extant Daozang ritual text is commonly treated as Tang-period (or later standardization), not securely Northern Dynasties.

results.title: 玄精碧匣靈寶聚玄經
results.issue: Content is mischaracterized as gathering xuan-qi / philosophical foundation for yangsheng. Daozang summaries identify it as a Song-era divination work (六壬遁甲 with Daoist talismans), not a neidan or yangsheng treatise.

results.title: 太上清靜元洞真文玉字妙經
results.issue: Over-reads the title’s 清靜 as stillness-based inner cultivation. Surviving text mainly explains 真文玉字 and writing/reciting true graphs for apotropaic ends, not a Qingjing-jing-style quietude classic.

results.title: 悟真篇小序（陆西星）
results.issue: The work is short poem-by-poem prefaces in 方壺外史; framing its method as 「觀天之道，執天之行」 imports a general Yin Fu / Fang Hu Wai Shi slogan rather than the actual structure of the 小序 itself.

results.title: 摄生消息论
results.issue: Traditionally titled to 丘處機 and widely so used, but Siku and modern reference works mark authorship as unproven/doubtful; the soft 「題」 label is right, yet the summary still presents it as a Quanzhen yangsheng imprint without that caveat.
